data.skills: BLDC Motors, PMSM Motors, Propulsion Systems, ESC Architecture, Motor Control, Field-Oriented Control (FOC), Sensorless Control, PWM Generation, Power Electronics, Motor Drives, Torque-Speed Analysis, Thrust Optimization, Propeller Matching, Thermal Management, Electrical Machines, PID Control, Embedded Systems, Microcontrollers, MATLAB, Simulink, Propulsion Testing, Vibration Analysis, Noise Analysis, Efficiency Optimization, UAV Propulsion, Motor Efficiency, System Validation, Hardware Testing, Data Analysis
data.eligibility_information:
Candidates will be considered only if they do not have any active backlogs in any academic year/semester. Candidates with previous backlogs will be considered only if all backlogs have been successfully cleared and passed.

Only candidates with no active backlogs and completed academic qualifications will be eligible for consideration.
data.additional_information:
Work on research and development of propulsion systems including BLDC motors, ESC architectures, motor control techniques, and propulsion optimization for unmanned aerial platforms.

 DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 
Research BLDC and PMSM motor operation for aerial propulsion applications. 
Study ESC architectures, switching strategies, and motor drive topologies. 
Analyze motor efficiency, thermal loading, and torque-speed characteristics.
Investigate field-oriented control (FOC) and sensorless motor control techniques. 
Study motor and propeller matching for endurance and thrust optimization. 
Evaluate propulsion subsystem behavior under varying mission conditions. 
Support testing and validation of propulsion hardware and ESC systems. 
Analyze vibration, noise, and thermal impact of propulsion systems. 
Benchmark commercial propulsion systems and emerging motor technologies. 
Prepare propulsion analysis reports and subsystem evaluation documents. 

Skills Required 
Strong understanding of electrical machines and motor fundamentals. 
Basic understanding of power electronics and switching systems. 
Familiarity with PWM generation and motor control principles. 
Understanding of torque, RPM, thrust, and efficiency relationships.
Ability to interpret electrical and mechanical test observations. 

PREFERRED SKILLS 
Exposure to ESC firmware or motor drive systems. 
Familiarity with MATLAB, Simulink, or equivalent analysis tools. 
Understanding of field-oriented control and PID control systems
Exposure to embedded systems and microcontroller programming. 
Basic understanding of propulsion system thermal management.

 QUALIFICATIONS-Phd/M.Tech/M.E
EXPERIENCE- 0-2 Yrs
data.additional_details:
Please find below the additional important details regarding our Company Clauses & Policies:

1.NDA – Non-Disclosure Agreement
Candidates must not disclose or share any confidential information related to their job role, projects, company operations, or work responsibilities with any external party. This clause will remain applicable for a lifetime.
2.NCC – Non-Compete Clause
Upon joining the company, when you decide to leave the organization in the future, you will not be eligible to join any direct competitor of the company for a period of 3 years post the last working day.
3.Minimum Service Agreement – 2 Years
Candidates from any branch having less than 2 Years of Experience are required to sign a mandatory 2-year Minimum Service Agreement. However, Candidates with more than 2 years of prior experience are exempted from the Minimum Service Agreement. Additionally breach of this agreement will result in a financial penalty of 40% of the CTC.
